_comment: Hand-written: iconic item per first-level area, keyed by the geoBoundaries ADM1 shapeName. tools/build_data.py merges this into data/countries/MYS.json.

Johor.lore: Malaysia's pineapple heartland around Pontian, at the southern tip of the peninsula; the causeway crosses to Singapore.

Kedah.lore: The 'Rice Bowl of Malaysia', with paddy plains around Alor Setar and the islands of Langkawi offshore.

Kelantan.lore: Home of the wau bulan, the moon kite on the 50 sen coin, flown at kite festivals on the east coast.

Malacca.lore: UNESCO old port city; the Porta de Santiago gate of the Portuguese fort A Famosa still stands.

Negeri Sembilan.lore: Minangkabau heritage: curved, horn-shaped roofs like the Istana Lama at Seri Menanti.

Pahang.lore: Tea terraces of the Cameron Highlands, plus Taman Negara, one of the oldest rainforests in the world.

Penang.lore: Street food capital: char kway teow and the street art and shophouses of George Town (UNESCO).

Perak.lore: The Kinta Valley once produced much of the world's tin; Ipoh grew rich on it.

Perlis.lore: Malaysia's smallest state, famous for the sweet Harumanis mango.

Sabah.lore: Mount Kinabalu (4,095 m), the highest peak in Malaysia, and Borneo's orangutans and reefs.

Sarawak.lore: The 'Land of the Hornbills', with the Mulu caves and longhouses along its rivers.

Selangor.lore: Fireflies glow along the Selangor River at Kuala Selangor; Batu Caves is here too.

Terengganu.lore: Turtles nest on its beaches, and the Perhentian and Redang islands lie offshore.

Kuala Lumpur.lore: The capital, with the Petronas Twin Towers joined by their skybridge.

Putrajaya.lore: The planned administrative capital; the rose-tinted dome of Putra Mosque rises over the lake.

Labuan.lore: Island territory off Borneo and an offshore oil and gas hub.
